projectDescription: DBImport is an ELT ingestion tool that automates importing, exporting, and orchestrating data flows between relational databases and Hadoop/Hive data lakehouses, with Airflow scheduling, multi-cluster replication, and Apache Atlas lineage tracking.
keyFeatures: Full and incremental import/export to Oracle, MSSQL, MySQL, DB2, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, and AWS S3
Auto-discovery of tables and views from source systems
Automatic schema change detection and propagation to Hive
Tight integration with Apache Airflow for scheduling and parallel execution
Multi-cluster replication via synchronous or asynchronous distcp
Apache Atlas integration for data governance and lineage tracking
Support for Oracle Flashback Query and MSSQL Change Tracking CDC
Spark and Hive ETL engines with ORC/Parquet/Iceberg table formats
Row count and custom SQL validation on every import/export
REST API server with JWT authentication for programmatic management
Statistics streaming to database tables, REST endpoints, or Kafka
publicApiSurface: bin/import — CLI for running table imports (-h, -t, -I, -C, -E flags)
bin/export — CLI for running table exports (-a, -S, -T flags)
bin/deploy — DAG deployment to remote instances (--deployAirflowImportDAG, --deployAirflowExportDAG)
POST /connection — Create or update a JDBC connection
GET /import/db — List all import target databases
POST /import/table/{database}/{table} — Create or update import table
POST /export/table/{connection}/{schema}/{table} — Create or update export table
POST /airflow/dags/import/{dagname} — Create or update import DAG
